theater_event_23_07_02_043:
What is the meaning of thiiis?!
Ms. Ais, with that dowdy, middle-aged,
third-rate adventurer?!
theater_event_23_07_02_045:
Impossible! He even looks like a thug!
A crude, grimy, lumpy, scruffy adventurer!
How could she be with someone like that?!
theater_event_23_07_02_046:
Um... I don't think he's a bad person deep
down... But I can't really argue with that...
theater_event_23_07_02_047:
The way Ms. Ais and he went leads to
the passage to the 17th floor...
theater_event_23_07_02_048:
So maybe they're going exploring, not on
a "d-date"...? But Mord did seem
weirdly giddy...
theater_event_23_07_02_049:
I'm going to find out!
After them, Bell Cranel!
theater_event_23_07_02_051:
So the two of them met up outside
the town of Rivira?
theater_event_23_07_02_052:
Yeah... Mord was all smiles and in a great
mood, so I was about to say hi, but then
Ms. Ais showed up...
theater_event_23_07_02_053:
And it was, um, kind of...
like a secret rendezvous...
theater_event_23_07_02_054:
Then why didn't you call out to them
right away?!
theater_event_23_07_02_055:
W-well, I mean...
What if the two of them were, um...
in that kind of relationship...
theater_event_23_07_02_056:
What are you thinking about,
you shameless rabbiiit?!
theater_event_23_07_02_057:
Then why didn't YOU call out to them
back there, Miss Lefiya?!
theater_event_23_07_02_058:
You'd make a maiden do such a thing?!
You sneaky, scheming, shameless rabbiiit!
theater_event_23_07_02_060:
They really went to the 17th floor...
Maybe they are exploring...
For a quest or something...
theater_event_23_07_02_061:
Impossible. Ms. Ais would never recruit help
to explore somewhere like the 17th floor.
Least of all from outside our Familia...
theater_event_23_07_02_062:
And the Goliath's interval should still
have quite a while to go.
theater_event_23_07_02_063:
Right...
Then it really is a "d-date"...
theater_event_23_07_02_064:
How do you keep getting there?!
Is your head full of nothing but
indecent thoughts?!
theater_event_23_07_02_065:
You're the one who ruled out
every other possibility!
theater_event_23_07_02_066:
Keep your voice down!
What if they find us?!
theater_event_23_07_02_068:
Anyway, we're following them! There has
to be a reason... There absolutely has to
be... Probably... Most likely...
theater_event_23_07_02_069:
I kind of wanted you to sound sure
about that part...
theater_event_23_07_03_071:
We've left the main route...
Where could they be going...?
theater_event_23_07_03_072:
I don't know...
I've never been to this area either...
theater_event_23_07_03_073:
There shouldn't be any strong monsters,
but let's proceed carefully.
theater_event_23_07_03_077:
...No, it's nothing.
Let's keep after them.
theater_event_23_07_03_079:
Ah, nothing to report.
The middle floors' main routes are as
peaceful as ever.
theater_event_23_07_03_080:
I see. I made a round of the upper floors
as well. No abnormalities there either.
theater_event_23_07_03_081:
That Irregular with the Goliath brought
fighting and quakes fierce enough to
reshape the terrain...
theater_event_23_07_03_082:
I can understand the Guild issuing a
mission to confirm the main routes are
safe, but...
theater_event_23_07_03_083:
There's a gag order on that Irregular,
you know. Don't go talking about it
carelessly.
theater_event_23_07_03_084:
Oh, right you are.
Anyway, the middle floors are clear.
theater_event_23_07_03_085:
...Though the two of us can't possibly
cover everything off the main routes.
theater_event_23_07_03_086:
Leave that to the Guild. Our job is
simply to secure the main routes.
theater_event_23_07_03_087:
Aye. So the fledglings on the upper
floors can explore safely. "Explore
safely" in the Dungeon—what a notion.
theater_event_23_07_03_088:
Keeping more adventurers from dying to
some unforeseen disaster... That's what
is being asked of us, I'd say.
theater_event_23_07_03_089:
Then let's look around a bit more on
our way back up. Just to be thorough.
theater_event_23_07_03_090:
I knew it... This area hasn't been
mapped...
theater_event_23_07_03_094:
...Why would Ms. Ais and Mord come
to a place like this...?
theater_event_23_07_03_095:
For that matter, those two... No, Ms. Ais,
who was leading the way, came here
without getting lost once.
theater_event_23_07_03_096:
As if she knew the place...
That's why it took me so long to realize
it was unexplored territory.
theater_event_23_07_03_097:
Th-then Ms. Ais knew this unexplored
area existed...?
theater_event_23_07_03_098:
It would seem so... And with no map,
one wrong turn and we could lose our
way back and end up stranded.
theater_event_23_07_03_100:
It's not impossible that she just
happened to find this unexplored area
and is going to explore it, but...
theater_event_23_07_03_101:
Then there'd be no reason to team up with
Mord, a Level 2 from another Familia...
theater_event_23_07_03_102:
No... there wouldn't.
It's like they came here to avoid
being seen.
theater_event_23_07_03_103:
To avoid being seen... So it really
is a rendezvous?
theater_event_23_07_04_111:
Bell Cranel!
Tend to that adventurer!
theater_event_23_07_04_117:
This wound... it's a sword cut...?!
A monster didn't do this...
theater_event_23_07_04_118:
Could there be a monster that caught
even Ms. Ais off guard? Is that why that
adventurer...
theater_event_23_07_04_133:
Bell Cranel?!
I'll cast a spell—!
theater_event_23_07_04_135:
As if a spell of mine could ever hit her...
Run? On our legs? From a first-tier
adventurer like Ms. Ais...?
theater_event_23_07_04_136:
What do I do... What can I do...
At this rate, all of us will—
theater_event_23_07_04_139:
Bell Cranel! When I cast my spell,
take that man and get out of here!
theater_event_23_07_05_148:
Y-yeah... Somehow...
What about Ms. Ais...?
theater_event_23_07_05_149:
She's on the other side of the rubble.
It was obvious she'd dodge anything
aimed straight at her, so...
theater_event_23_07_05_150:
You brought the ceiling down
to cut her off...?
theater_event_23_07_05_151: Yes. It was all I could think of...
theater_event_23_07_05_154:
Huh...? Little Rookie...?
What am I... Ah?!
theater_event_23_07_05_155:
Where's the Sword Princess?!
She came at me out of nowhere...!
theater_event_23_07_05_156:
Ms. Ais is on the other side of
that rubble...
theater_event_23_07_05_158:
Mord... What happened?
Why were you with Ms. Ais...?
theater_event_23_07_05_159:
...She invited me.
She was givin' me the eye, kinda...
theater_event_23_07_05_160:
There's no way that's true!
Not to a middle-aged, third-rate,
scruffy adventurer like you...!
theater_event_23_07_05_161:
It's the truth, so what am I s'posed
to do?! And why do I gotta take
that kinda abuse anyway?!
theater_event_23_07_05_162:
...Mord, given the situation,
please tell us exactly what happened.
Please...
theater_event_23_07_05_163:
Ugh... Tch. Forget the eye thing... In
Rivira, she just beckoned me over. With a
smile, too, which ain't like her...
theater_event_23_07_05_164:
Ms. Ais... smiled?
At an adventurer from another Familia...?
theater_event_23_07_05_165:
Um... So then you came here and
Ms. Ais cut you down...?
theater_event_23_07_05_166:
Yeah, right when we got here.
And for the record, I didn't do nothin'.
theater_event_23_07_05_167:
Yeah... Even if you tried something
with Ms. Ais, she'd obviously just
beat you to a pulp...
theater_event_23_07_05_168:
You've got some mouth on you too,
Little Rookie! Sayin' it with a
straight face makes it even worse!
theater_event_23_07_05_169:
She just cut down an adventurer she
found physically repulsive...? No, no
matter how disgusted, she'd never...
theater_event_23_07_05_170:
You too! Why's the one thing you're
sure about that I'm physically
repulsive?!
theater_event_23_07_05_171:
So the facts are, Ms. Ais invited
Mord here, and then cut him down
without doing anything else...
theater_event_23_07_05_172:
Yes... There's too much that doesn't
add up.
theater_event_23_07_05_173:
If getting rid of Mord was the goal,
she could've done it in the forest
on the 18th floor...
theater_event_23_07_05_174:
Yes, an adventurer like this would take
her a few seconds... No, he'd be done
for in an instant...
theater_event_23_07_05_175: Could you two be any more morbid?!
theater_event_23_07_05_176:
Geez, why do I gotta get this treatment
from a pair like you, all lovey-dovey
on a "date" in the Dungeon...
theater_event_23_07_05_177:
D-d-d-date?!
With this shameless rabbit?! Me?!
theater_event_23_07_05_178:
Ain't it? You're from different Familias,
but you're wearin' similar clothes. What's
it called? "Matchin' outfits"?
theater_event_23_07_05_179:
Pure coincidence! Never, ever, for all
eternity, will there be any "dates" or
"matching outfits" with this rabbit!!
theater_event_23_07_06_181:
—First, let's focus on getting back
to the main route.
theater_event_23_07_06_182:
Thanks to the cave-in I caused, we can't
just go back the way we came... We'll map
as we go and find the main route...
theater_event_23_07_06_183:
Um... You can do mapping,
Miss Lefiya?
theater_event_23_07_06_184:
I'm nothing next to a professional mapper,
but I've learned the basics.
It's better than nothing.
theater_event_23_07_06_185: Miss Lefiya, what about Ms. Ais...?
theater_event_23_07_06_187:
Right now, all we think about is getting
out of this unexplored area.
theater_event_23_07_06_189:
A trick like mine could never injure
Ms. Ais... Never.
theater_event_23_07_06_191:
Even if... she did take a little damage...
The chances of her being in danger on
the middle floors are close to zero.
theater_event_23_07_06_192:
Figuring out what happened to Ms. Ais...
We can only do that if we make it out
alive.
theater_event_23_07_06_195:
Unless there's some major Irregular,
the 17th floor—
theater_event_23_07_06_196:
—the middle floors shouldn't pose any
danger to three upper-class adventurers
like us.
theater_event_23_07_06_197:
...As long as we don't run into the
Sword Princess.
theater_event_23_07_06_199:
Prepare for the worst—that's the iron
rule of adventurers, ain't it? If she
shows up and comes at us again...
theater_event_23_07_07_214:
Still—Lefiya has changed since that last
expedition. On top of her natural magic
power, she's finding some nerve.
theater_event_23_07_07_215:
If you dawdle, she might become a great
mage who surpasses even you, eh?
theater_event_23_07_07_216:
She's still far too unsteady to reach that
level. But... she does embody the heart of
the great tree more and more often.
theater_event_23_07_07_217:
Gahahaha! If she could keep that mindset
all the time, you'd finally have a fire
lit under you!
theater_event_23_07_07_218:
I'd be troubled if she didn't. Though
I'm hardly in Lefiya's sights for now.
theater_event_23_07_07_220:
Lately, Lefiya seems to have chosen a
rival. The boy we met here on the 18th
floor, on our way back from the expedition—
theater_event_23_07_07_221:
Ah, that lad.
He had good eyes.
theater_event_23_07_07_222:
Her rivalry with that boy seems to be
pushing her in a good direction.
theater_event_23_07_07_223:
Heh... All the better.
That's how the young should be.
theater_event_23_07_07_224:
Blow, thrice-fallen winter—
my name is Alf!
Wynn Fimbulvetr!
theater_event_23_07_07_226:
H-hey... Ain't that overdoin' it
a little...?
theater_event_23_07_07_227:
Speed matters more than anything right
now! We don't have time to waste on
monsters!
theater_event_23_07_07_229:
Even talking is a waste of time!
Let's go!
theater_event_23_07_07_230:
Is she okay...? She's way too
wound up, if ya ask me...
theater_event_23_07_07_234:
Crap... They heard that and came running!
Come on, Little Rookie!
theater_event_23_07_07_239:
Dammit! They just keep comin'!
Ain't we at the main route yet?!
theater_event_23_07_08_249:
He's alive...!
Then what I need to do right now is—!
theater_event_23_07_08_250:
If, by some chance, that happens...
think only about escaping.
theater_event_23_07_08_251:
Whatever it takes... make even a moment's
opening and run—
I'll buy you that time.
theater_event_23_07_08_270: There's no way she was okay with this...
theater_event_23_07_08_271:
Having to fight Ms. Ais... after surviving
so many close calls with her... after Ms.
Ais saved her so many times...
theater_event_23_07_08_273:
Leaving this elf—
no matter how strong she is! Leaving a
girl to fight a battle like this—!
theater_event_23_07_09_281:
Bell Cranel, who should be weaker than me,
is holding off Ms. Ais—?!
theater_event_23_07_09_291:
A weakling like you, sacrificing yourself
to save me...? You're a million years
too early for that!
theater_event_23_07_09_292:
Accept what you can't do!
Don't go throwing your life away!
theater_event_23_07_09_293:
We can't get through this if either of us
falls! Think only about surviving!
Because you and I are both—
theater_event_23_07_09_294:
—adventurers who cling to life
no matter what!
theater_event_23_07_09_297:
But... from here on!
I'll focus on nothing but surviving too!
theater_event_23_07_09_299:
Whatever it takes...
however unsightly we have to be—we're
going home alive!
theater_event_23_07_10_306:
The plan hasn't changed.
Our goal is still to get out of here—
theater_event_23_07_10_307:
Keep Ms. Ais in check, and if you
have room to spare, thin out the
monsters. Nothing more.
theater_event_23_07_10_308:
Don't even think about standing your ground
against Ms. Ais. While you buy us time—
theater_event_23_07_10_309:
I'll fire off area spells one after
another and force an escape route
through the monster horde.
theater_event_23_07_10_311:
I hope my magic makes Ms. Ais flinch even
for a moment... But I won't count on it.
Once there's an opening, we charge.
theater_event_23_07_10_312:
Got it—I just need to keep the monsters
and Ms. Ais away from you,
Miss Lefiya...?
theater_event_23_07_10_313:
Yes... Honestly, you're the very last
person I'd ever want to ask this of, but...
theater_event_23_07_10_314:
Protect me—
and I swear I'll save you!
theater_event_23_07_10_316:
In the name of Wishe, I beseech thee.
Ancestors of the forest, my proud
brethren—
theater_event_23_07_11_344:
Yes... Not even a potion or magic could...
No, it didn't just heal—it repaired her
armor in an instant. That's impossible.
theater_event_23_07_11_346:
Well then, shall we be off?
We can check a few spots off the main
route on our way to the surface.
theater_event_23_07_11_349: I'll... come with you, I guess...
theater_event_23_07_11_350:
Now that I think about it, everything
was strange... In that first fight, a
spell of mine actually caught her open...
theater_event_23_07_11_351:
You weren't killed instantly despite the
Level gap... She didn't react to the Crystal
Drop... And above all—
theater_event_23_07_11_352:
The monsters didn't attack her...
No, she didn't even treat the monsters
as enemies...
theater_event_23_07_11_353:
The move I used to "wound" her...
Ms. Ais is the one who taught it to me...
theater_event_23_07_11_354:
So she fell for a technique she taught
you herself... That settles it.
theater_event_23_07_11_357:
Bell Cranel—
can you buy me a little more time?
theater_event_23_07_11_359:
The plan has— No... I suppose I should
say I've changed my mind.
theater_event_23_07_11_360:
That thing is trampling on something it
must never touch... It's defiling something
that must never be sullied...!
theater_event_23_07_11_364:
I am Lefiya Viridis!
An elf of the Wishe Forest!
theater_event_23_07_11_366:
A member of the strongest, greatest
Familia in Orario, bound by oath to
the god Loki!!
theater_event_23_07_11_367:
I will not forgive anything that degrades
a beloved comrade who shares the same
Ichor as me—!
theater_event_23_07_11_371:
The heights I'm aiming for—I won't
forgive anything that defiles the
adventurer I look up to—!
theater_event_23_07_11_372:
—Let's do this, Miss Lefiya.
I feel... exactly the same way!
theater_event_23_07_11_374:
One more time! Just once more, follower of
the hearth goddess, I ask you!
Protect me!
theater_event_23_07_11_375:
On the pride of my people! I swear to save
you—and to destroy that thing!
theater_event_23_07_12_386:
This is... the monster that was
impersonating Ms. Ais...?
theater_event_23_07_12_387:
It looks like an ooze, but it's not...
I've never heard of a monster that can
mimic someone so perfectly...
theater_event_23_07_12_389:
It must have lived unnoticed in this sealed
unexplored area... Either way, there's no
reason to leave it be.
theater_event_23_07_12_393:
Is someone there?!
If so, answer!
theater_event_23_07_12_397:
A monster that turns into people is hard
to swallow... but looking at the two of
you, I can't call it a lie.
theater_event_23_07_12_398:
Yes... We still can't believe it either,
but we clearly saw it reveal its true form.
theater_event_23_07_12_399:
It couldn't copy a first-tier adventurer's
fighting strength, it seems, but on the
outside it was nearly...
theater_event_23_07_12_400:
Either way, this goes to Finn and the
Guild. It may be more than even we can
handle.
theater_event_23_07_12_401:
Aye. Mimics an adventurer... lures folk in
and makes a meal of them. Just thinking
about it gives me the chills.
theater_event_23_07_12_402:
This is only a guess... but I doubt this
will ever be made public. Tamed and
misused... I'd rather not imagine it.
theater_event_23_07_12_403:
Heh, another gag order, is it? You truly
do have a knack for Irregulars, lad.
theater_event_23_07_12_405:
Well, leave the rest to us. There's
another injured man, and you two need
to rest first.
theater_event_23_07_12_408:
What is it, Ais?
Done scouting the area already?
theater_event_23_07_12_409: Mm. I cleared out the monsters.
theater_event_23_07_12_412: A-a-are you really the real Ms. Ais?!
theater_event_23_07_12_414:
I-it's not another monster in disguise...
is it?!
theater_event_23_07_12_416:
Ah, well, you see...
Ais, could you not go near those two
for now?
theater_event_23_07_12_417:
Seems the sight of you is a bit much
for them at the moment...
theater_event_24_01_01_010: What is this—could it be an attack?!
theater_event_24_01_01_012:
Huh? Ryu, what's wrong?
Why the scary face?
theater_event_24_01_01_014:
—Ngh, what is... that object?! It reeks
of all the evil in the world boiled
down into one sinister stench!
theater_event_24_01_01_015:
What do you mean? It's chocolate!
I wanted to practice with what we had
before the shop opened.
theater_event_24_01_01_017:
This thing, whose stench would send even
deep-floor monsters reeking of blood and
death running for their lives...?
theater_event_24_01_01_018:
Ugh... ah...
They made us taste-test that-nya...
theater_event_24_01_01_019:
She waved it under our noses, and while
we were all woozy, it was
"Say aaah"...
theater_event_24_01_01_020:
Ehehe, was it good?
Chocolate... I wonder if Bell will
like it?
theater_event_24_01_01_021:
Stop-nya! Feed him this and
White-Hair will drop dead on the spot!
theater_event_24_01_01_022:
Save my beautiful butt-nya!
Not even you have the right to take away
that boy's precious behind, Syr!
theater_event_24_01_01_023:
Hmm... I guess there's still room
for improvement...
theater_event_24_01_01_024:
But don't worry! I'll practice lots before
the big day! I even had Ryu buy
more ingredients for me.
theater_event_24_01_01_025:
Ryu! What have you done-nya?!
Why help her mass-produce
these hazards?!
theater_event_24_01_01_026:
This is the start of a deadly Valentine's!
You take responsibility and taste-test
all of it-nya!
theater_event_24_01_01_027:
What are you lot fooling around for?!
We open soon! Hurry up and get ready!!
theater_event_24_01_01_028:
—Good work today, Ryu.
We were super busy again.
theater_event_24_01_01_029:
Are you going to practice making
chocolate now, Syr?
theater_event_24_01_01_030:
Yep. Valentine's is coming up...
and I want to give Bell some
yummy chocolate.
theater_event_24_01_01_031:
Still... what a strange custom
to have caught on.
theater_event_24_01_01_032:
Confessing your feelings in public and
handing out chocolate... It's unthinkable
to elves.
theater_event_24_01_01_033:
Hehe. Entrusting your melting love
to sweet, sweet chocolate—
theater_event_24_01_01_034:
It might bring you a little closer to that
someone you can never seem to reach...
Isn't that a wonderful day?
theater_event_24_01_01_035:
It's a custom I can't begin to
understand, but...
theater_event_24_01_01_036:
I support your feelings with all my heart.
If there's anything I can do, please
just say so.
theater_event_24_01_01_037:
Thank you! Then can I ask one thing right
now?! See, I'd love for you to taste-test
this chocolate!
theater_event_24_01_01_039:
You won't...?
But Ryu, you said anything...
theater_event_24_01_01_040:
Syr! Wait! I need to prepare myself...
Gh... GWAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!
theater_event_24_01_01_041:
—What's wrong, Lion?
You look rather pale.
theater_event_24_01_01_042:
I ate something a little potent.
I never imagined it would have such
destructive power...
theater_event_24_01_01_043:
I have nothing but a bad feeling about
this... Is that why you called me here?
theater_event_24_01_01_044:
Yes... Though what I want to ask you
is simple.
theater_event_24_01_01_045:
A magic item that makes any sweets
come out delicious—
theater_event_24_01_01_046:
Or some miracle seasoning with the same
effect... Do you know of anything
like that?
theater_event_24_01_01_048:
D-don't look at me like I'm out of my
mind!
theater_event_24_01_01_049:
Pardon me... For a moment your absurd
request overlapped with one of Lord
Hermes's...
theater_event_24_01_01_050:
But unfortunately, that's beyond me.
